title: Linear-function reconstruction with causal bounded errors and paid precision
summary: Adaptive bounded scalar measurements of a hidden Euclidean vector are priced by their requested tolerance. The objective is uniform reconstruction, allowing arbitrary prediction outputs.

description_paragraphs: Reconstruct the hidden linear function $f_\theta(x)=\langle\theta,x\rangle$ uniformly on $B_2^d$. This is an information-reconstruction task with a paid precision resource.
task.formulation: Reconstruct the hidden linear function $f_\theta(x)=\langle\theta,x\rangle$ uniformly on $B_2^d$. This is an information-reconstruction task with a paid precision resource.

description_paragraphs: The hidden target is one fixed vector $\theta\in B_2^d$. Its function is defined on the public Euclidean unit ball. The target remains unchanged throughout the interaction.

assumptions.description: The hidden target is one fixed vector $\theta\in B_2^d$. Its function is defined on the public Euclidean unit ball. The target remains unchanged throughout the interaction.
assumptions.scope: The domain stated in this clause.

description_paragraphs: A query chooses $(x_t,\delta_t)$ with $x_t\in B_2^d$ and $0<\delta_t\le1$. It returns a real $Y_t$ satisfying $$|Y_t-\langle\theta,x_t\rangle|\le\delta_t,$$ at cost $\delta_t^{-a}$, where $a>0$ is public.

The error rule may depend causally on the target, the current query, and the public past transcript. It cannot depend on future queries or unrevealed private random bits. Repeated queries need not receive the same error. No stochastic centering, independence, or distributional assumption is imposed.
Public inputs are $d,a,\varepsilon,\eta$. The target and legal causal error rule are fixed before averaging over private algorithmic randomness.

description_paragraphs: Return any prediction function $\widehat f:B_2^d\to\mathbb R$ encoded measurably by the transcript and seed. The output is not required to be linear. All query, oracle, and output maps are measurable, and the uniform-error success event is jointly measurable.

description_paragraphs: The loss is uniform prediction error $$\sup_{x\in B_2^d}|\widehat f(x)-\langle\theta,x\rangle|.$$

description_paragraphs: The paid resource is $B=\sum_{t=1}^N\delta_t^{-a}$. The budget must hold on every legal execution and every private seed. Each call costs at least one, so $N\le\lfloor B\rfloor$. Internal computation and storage are uncharged.

components.description: Its accounting convention is stated in the resource paragraphs.

description_paragraphs: Queries, stopping decisions, and the output are measurable functions of the preceding transcript and an instance-independent private random seed. The unknown instance is fixed before the seed is realized. No span, support, zero-respecting, or memory restriction is imposed.
Internal exact-real computation and storage using public inputs and received information are uncharged. The stated budget must hold on every execution path.
Only the independent private seed is randomized in the guarantee. The target and causal oracle are fixed first. The budget remains valid on every legal path.
